item.title: Celcuity gedatolisib breast cancer Phase 3 win
item.description:
• Summary: Celcuity reported positive Phase 3 results for gedatolisib in PIK3CA-mutant HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer, showing superiority over Novartis's Piqray (alpelisib) in combination with fulvestrant.
  • MoAs: Gedatolisib: dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitor; Alpelisib: PI3Kα inhibitor
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive, Fierce Biotech

item.title: Summit Therapeutics PD-1/VEGF asset misses survival mark
item.description:
• Summary: Summit Therapeutics shares fell as its PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody ivonescimab missed an early survival endpoint in a clinical trial, raising questions about its efficacy in oncology.
  • MoAs: PD-1 inhibition and VEGF inhibition (bispecific antibody)
  • Sources: BioSpace

item.title: FDA clears Pfizer/Arvinas breast cancer therapy
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA cleared Pfizer and Arvinas's novel breast cancer therapy vepdegestrant, an estrogen receptor degrader, despite mixed clinical data, offering a new option for ER+ breast cancer.
  • MoAs: PROTAC-mediated degradation of estrogen receptor
  • Sources: BioSpace
